how.label: How Voxtera works
how.title: Three seconds from hello to helpful.
how.step1_desc: No selection screens. No phrasebooks. The guest just speaks — Voxtera detects the language automatically from the first utterance.
how.step2_desc: A private knowledge layer holds your menus, hours, room amenities, local recommendations and house rules — so answers are your answers.
how.step3_desc: A native-sounding voice responds in the guest's own language. Under one second, end-to-end. Interruptible like a real conversation.

features.label: What it actually does
features.title: A concierge that never clocks out.
features.intro: Voxtera replaces the gap between front-desk shifts — and supplements it during the day. It picks up the lobby phone, the in-room dial, the web chat, and the WhatsApp call, with the same fluency every time.
features.f1_desc: Room service, check-in queries, late checkout, spa bookings, wake-up calls — handled in the guest's language, logged for your team.
features.f2_desc: Pulls from your curated list of restaurants, walks and attractions — not the open internet. Your preferred vendors stay preferred.
features.f3_desc: Embed Voxtera on your booking page, route your existing phone line through it, or drop it into your guest app. One platform, three ways to reach you.
features.f4_desc: Medical, security or emotional escalations are flagged and routed to a human in real time — no guest is ever stuck with a bot when it matters.
features.f5_title: Tickets out, to the tools you already use
features.f5_desc: Every guest request becomes a structured ticket — posted to your team's Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, or SMS group, translated into their language. No new app for your staff to learn.
features.f6_desc: A Japanese guest calls at 3am. By 3:05am your night manager has a clean English summary in their inbox: "Guest in Room 412 requested a late checkout to 2pm. Confirmed." Every call, every language, translated automatically.
features.f7_desc: Every call ends with a structured summary pushed to your CRM or PMS — guest preferences captured, follow-ups scheduled, complaints surfaced.
features.f8_desc: See active conversations, languages in use, common questions and escalation rates. Tune answers from a web admin without code.

faq.label: Questions, briefly answered
faq.title: Things people always ask.
faq.q1: How fast is the response, really?
faq.a1: End-to-end — from the moment the guest stops speaking to the first syllable of Voxtera's reply — averages 600 to 850 milliseconds. That's faster than most human pickups on a hotel phone, and well within the threshold where conversation feels natural.
faq.a2: Voxtera stops immediately, listens, and continues the new thread — like a real conversation, not a robocall menu.
faq.q3: How does it know about my property?
faq.a3: During onboarding we ingest your menus, room amenities, hours, house rules, local recommendations and FAQs into a private knowledge layer. Updates take seconds — change your spa hours and Voxtera knows on the next call.
faq.q4: What about escalating to a real person?
faq.a4: Anything safety-related, medical, or emotionally distressed is flagged in real time and routed to a staff member via the channel you specify — Slack, SMS, internal phone. Voxtera stays with the guest until the handover completes.
faq.a5: Infrastructure is deployed in the region closest to your property — North America, Europe, or other regions as needed. We work with trusted subprocessors and select hosting regions per deployment. Full details on data routing and subprocessors are available on request. All conversations are encrypted in transit and at rest; recordings can be disabled per-property.
faq.q6: Can it handle a phone line, not just web?
faq.a6: Yes. We'll work with you to connect Voxtera to your existing phone system — so the same brain, the same voices, and the same languages reach every guest who calls in.
faq.q7: Can it connect to the systems we already use?
faq.a7: Yes. Voxtera can connect to your management system and open customer tickets automatically — or route every guest request straight to your team's Telegram, WhatsApp, or Slack. Your staff stay in the tools they already know.

hotels.hero_title: From guest request, to your team's chat, in seconds.
hotels.hero_sub: Voxtera answers in the guest's language, creates a ticket, and sends it to the team tool you already use — Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, or your PMS. No app installs. No training. No gap between shifts.
hotels.loop_intro: Every guest interaction follows the same reliable path — from voice to action, in the tools your team already checks.
hotels.step1_desc: In any language — on the web widget, the room phone, or WhatsApp.
hotels.step2_desc: Speech-to-text, language detection, and intent extraction in one pass.
hotels.step3_desc: Structured: room, category, urgency, guest language, full transcript.
hotels.step4_desc: Posted to Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, SMS, or your PMS — instantly.
hotels.step5_desc: Staff marks it done; the guest can receive a follow-up in their language.
hotels.cap_title: Six categories. One bot. Every language.
hotels.cap_intro: Every request your guests make falls into one of these. Voxtera handles them end-to-end, in the guest's language, and turns each into a structured action for the right team.
hotels.channels_intro: Voxtera doesn't ask your staff to learn a new app. It posts directly into whatever you already use to coordinate — so the cleaner gets a Telegram message in Portuguese, the night manager gets a Slack ping in English, and your PMS gets the structured ticket for audit.
hotels.timeline_label: A single request, start to finish
hotels.timeline_title: From "more towels, please" to delivered — in 8 minutes.
hotels.timeline_intro: A typical Voxtera ticket flow, end-to-end. Eight minutes, zero language barriers, zero handoffs lost. The kind of call that used to take fifteen minutes — and a translator — now resolves while the guest is still unpacking.
hotels.et_label: Your existing tools, not new ones
hotels.et_title: No new app. No login. No training week.
hotels.dd_intro: Every vendor lists features. We list what we won't do — because operators have been burned by products that promised everything and delivered chaos. Voxtera has a deliberate, narrow scope.
hotels.early_access_text: Now accepting pilot properties — boutique hotels, residences, and vacation rental groups.
hotels.form_intro: Three short blocks. Ninety seconds. By the end, we'll both know whether a fifteen-minute conversation is worth scheduling — and what to lead with if it is.
